source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common identity; adjacent 0x48-0x4A records and this exact source establish an IPMI SOL session-payload workflow.

source_snapshot.procedure: Activate one OOB SOL session, issue App 0x06/0x4B in-band and out-of-band, copy returned bytes into App 0x06/0x3D Get Session Info, deactivate SOL, then query 0x4B again; generic pre-step also requests configuration verification and log clearing.
source_snapshot.criteria: SOL activation and both reads succeed; Get Session Info returns completion 00; SOL deactivation succeeds; final 0x4B response is 00 00 00 00.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: ipmitool raw workflow; expected response must be supplied

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL recognizes tooling but does not resolve unsafe byte-copy/session selection.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; preserve the state-changing SOL objective but parse 0x4B/0x3D schemas instead of blindly copying bytes.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Adjacent Activate/Deactivate/Status reviews establish IPMI session-payload rather than firmware semantics.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 makes target/session/schema inputs Project-specific; ED-35 preserves activate/deactivate coverage; ED-38 forbids retry.

original_test_intent: Verify that an active IPMI SOL payload instance can be inventoried consistently through in-band and out-of-band paths, correlated to its session, and shown inactive after controlled teardown.
original_method: Use the preserved SOL activation, App 0x06/0x4B payload-instance read, schema-correct App 0x06/0x3D session lookup, one SOL deactivation and a final 0x4B inactive-state read.
manual_activity: Engineer approves a dedicated SOL session and exact firmware schemas; operator confirms the owned session immediately before the single activation/deactivation lifecycle.
safety_requirements: Do not copy an entire 0x4B response into 0x3D without field mapping
Activate and deactivate only the owned SOL payload
agent_execution_scope: Perform bounded IB/OOB reads and decoded correlation
engineer_actions: Own anomaly and final DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial: the commands address the right IPMI domain but need protected credentials, exact field parsing and lifecycle controls.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Project-approved protected ipmitool or equivalent wrapper for 0x4B and 0x3D, with explicit decoded selectors; never embed -P credentials.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original raw commands and 10/5 timing remain preserved in Master.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline sessions, activate one dedicated SOL payload, query 0x4B over both required paths, derive the exact 0x3D selector from decoded fields, correlate session identity, deactivate once, then verify the selected payload inactive and all unrelated sessions healthy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Retains all functional checkpoints while replacing unsafe opaque byte copying and log clearing with schema-qualified correlation and scoped evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only the approved payload type/instance and transports are covered; one successful path cannot substitute for the other.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong selector or teardown can disclose or terminate another management session.

project_override_considerations: Alternate tools are acceptable only if they preserve IB/OOB payload-instance reads, exact session correlation, controlled lifecycle and independent inactive-state evidence.
expected_evidence: Exact 0x4B IB/OOB responses and decoded fields
Final inactive state plus unrelated-session/BMC health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title says IB while the procedure also requires OOB SOL, the generic pre-step asks to clear logs, and the procedure blindly copies example 0x4B bytes into 0x3D without schema-qualified selector mapping; final all-zero acceptance is not firmware/schema scoped.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The core standard command lifecycle is identifiable; schemas, owned target, credentials and approval are Project execution-readiness inputs rather than a permanent review block.

review_improvement: Separates both transport checkpoints, session-field correlation and teardown evidence while preserving functional coverage and preventing unsafe session selection.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a hybrid read/state-changing SOL session test: the reads are deterministic, but creating and destroying a live management payload requires an owned target, exact schemas and point-of-action approval. Read-only evidence alone would not satisfy the original lifecycle, so REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION is appropriate.
